reason_for_new_id: Long-horizon v1 was blocked by source history entitlement before PnL. This shorter-horizon rule is a new protocol designed only from data availability, not performance.

data.gap_rule: Any weekly observation requiring a missing common-session lookback, decision, entry or exit bar for any universe member is ineligible. No fallback date or ticker substitution.

signal.decision: Last common US trading session of each ISO week after the close.
signal.score: (close_at_t_minus_5 - close_at_t_minus_63 + sum(split_adjusted_cash_dividends with ex_date > t_minus_63 and <= t_minus_5)) / close_at_t_minus_63
signal.ranking: Descending score; ties alphabetically by ticker.
signal.original_portfolio: Long top 3, equal target weight 1/3 each.
signal.reversed_control: Long bottom 3, equal target weight 1/3 each.
signal.benchmark: Long all 10, equal target weight 0.1 each.

execution.entry: Next common US trading session open after decision.
execution.holding_return: (exit_open - entry_open + sum(split_adjusted_cash_dividends with ex_date > entry_date and <= exit_date)) / entry_open
execution.turnover_proxy: 0.5 * sum(abs(target_weight_t - target_weight_previous)) across all 10 ETFs; initial prior weights zero.
execution.limitation: Target-membership turnover proxy ignores small drift-restoration trades when membership is unchanged. Frozen before results.
